data.notes: The report gets the core story right. The real trigger was the CFO's nine-day close, not the portal. The win came from a value case built on her own data ('that's my number, not yours'), with no dollar figure invented and Fiserv's pitch kept unknown. Weaknesses: 'She let it go' is labelled fact rather than opinion, and the trigger section claims the rep's story 'contradicts itself' over the off-the-shelf portal when it doesn't. The close also calls the 'questions after the bank' item 'dodged' even though Dana answered it. The counter-reader demo appears only in the gaps section, not in the messaging changes.
